title: Citus: PostgreSQL roles via the operator (CREATE ROLE propagates to workers)
description: Runs `nexus acl citus {list,grant,revoke}` via the operator over the coordinator VIP. CREATE ROLE on the coordinator auto-propagates to the workers (citus.enable_create_role_propagation); the operator/system/app roles are revoke-protected.

observe.what: lists PG roles with attribute flags: nexus-cluster-admin LOGIN CREATEROLE CREATEDB, citus_app LOGIN, postgres SUPERUSER, replicator REPLICATION
nexus_report created (LOGIN) + GRANT CONNECT on citus; Citus propagates the role to both workers
CONNECT revoked from nexus_report (round-trip clean); protected roles refuse revoke

whatProves: CitusAdapter.AclAsync manages PG roles via the operator over the coordinator VIP: list reads pg_roles; grant CREATE ROLE + GRANT (auto-propagated to workers by Citus); revoke is refused for the operator/system/app roles.
